prompt: Complete the Manager class, which extends the provided Employee class. Store a bonus, call the superclass constructor with super, and override pay() so a manager earns base salary plus bonus.
explanation: A subclass constructor must hand the shared state (name, base salary) to the superclass with super(...), then initialize only its own new field. Overriding pay() replaces the base behavior, and the override is used even when the object is held in an Employee variable -- that is dynamic dispatch. Because baseSalary is private in Employee, the subclass reads it through the getter.
hints: Declare private double bonus; in Manager and assign it in the constructor after the super(...) call.
In pay(), you cannot touch the private baseSalary field directly -- use the inherited getBaseSalary() getter.
pay() should return getBaseSalary() + bonus; getBonus() just returns the field.
